title: Import - Verify that user should be able to configure multiple columns in bulk by using import functionality.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
Pop up window for file upload should open

steps.action: Select the file and click on the upload button
steps.expectedResult: File should be upload successfully and uploaded column should be display in the list
